📖 How to use

  1. Pick the date.
  2. Enter your longitude (−180 to 180).
  3. Enter your timezone's UTC offset.
  4. Press Calculate for your solar noon time.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is solar noon?

Solar noon is when the sun crosses your meridian — its highest point. It rarely matches 12:00 because of your longitude within the timezone and Earth's elliptical orbit.

What is the equation of time?

The equation of time corrects for Earth's elliptical orbit and axial tilt — it swings about ±16 minutes through the year and is built into the calculation.

How do I find my longitude?

Use a maps app or search 'my coordinates' — any decimal longitude between −180 and 180 works.
